content: Tabin Forag an Dura Kawen
Iesu dura kawenai nan sabu auris idudur men.
On iyau, “Safam an Baiaiwab on ato nanaba. Ra tani aiwab orot natun an tabin aurin an forag ibotitiwag.
On an agirotis iyafares sinai sabu ibibebegis on sitawures sitnat on an forag aurin, baise osi men sigogoi sitnat.

On mes on an agirotis fani ba iyafares men, on dura ato nanaba iyau: ‘Yau au forag on abotitiwag nono; au foro tona bobous a au foro bobous momos arou aweyaben, ato engon tutufin abotitiwagen nono. Omi wonnat tabin an forag aurin!’
Baise sabu ibibebegis on men fonan sitatam on, ato osi asi gogoi nanaba bobo ta ta auris sinai: orot tani on inai an masau aurin, orot tani on inai an baitotobon goa aurin,
ato sabu fani on simisir agirotis siboes siborarabis a siyasububunues.
Aiwab orot on yan itatab kwakwan; on mes on an wou yangan iyafares sinai osi iyabon simisir agirotis siyasububunues on, angaramin siyasububunues a asi mafam gagamin on sikubarai iyaras.
Namon on an agirotis fani ba iyores ato auris iyau, ‘Yau au tabin forag on abotitiwag nono, baise sabu abibebegis on men obis on au baibebeg dura sitboai.
Omi wonan eta gagaminai sabu sigaraba wongagatures on, wonibebegis sinnat forag aurin.’
On mes agirotis sigat sinai etai nan sabu komasis a sabu obis sigatures on engon siruayois; ato tabin an goa on sabu wat awan ibonu.
“Aiwab orot irui sabu ibibebegis on itites mes ato on matan ireben orot tani men tabin an beber imomonag on it.
Aiwab orot on orot itetemai iyau, ‘Turau, om men tabin an beber umonag on, ato om mamaba urui nin?’ Baise orot on men abi dura tani iyau on.
Namon aiwab orot on an agirotis iyawures iyau, ‘Orot ann iman wofatumen ato kounai worebetet ingat, on nan womanai inama. On arimon nan inatou wan initafoforen.’”
Ato Iesu an dudur kanfounai iyau, “Sabu sigaraba on God ebibebegis ato sabu ruamom wat on erurubines.”
Agim Takes Yeinin aurin Sitetem
Pharisee yangan sinai asi bainonot on sidudurai Iesu sitbitetemai on nan sitrutobonai mes.

Namon osi baigibubunuotis fani a Herod an sabu fani on siyafares sinai Iesu aurin. Osi siyau, “Baibebeotim, wei wasagob Om on dura bag wat ebikakafun. Om on God an dura maiauinai wat on sabu auris ebibebe, Om sabu was men ekakair on, yabin Om on men sabu asi baibad aurin enonosin on.
Ekasonei, Om mamaba enonosin? Ot ati baifafaro iyau ibasit fofonin arimon agim takes on Rome asi aiwab orot Caesar aurin tanyein o ambin?”
Baise osi asi bainonot komasin sidudurai on Iesu isagob, on mes iyau, “Omi baisigogo’otim! Omi aibo mes wofofourtobon Yau wotrutoboniu mes i?
Agim ato takes woyeyeinin on wobo wonat woiyoboeu anitai!” Osi agim sibo sinat,
ato On itetemis iyau, “Atonio agim on iyafan magin a wabin?”
Osi siyafotai siyau, “Caesar.” On mes Iesu osi auris iyau, “Basit, sawar aifan Caesar noan on Caesar wonitai, a sawar aifan God noan on God wonitai.”
Osi atonio dura sitatam on siduduran; ato osi Iesu sikirir sinai.
Rabob emon Misir aurin Sitetem
On ra kaitamom Sadducee yangan sinat Iesu aurin, osi sebikakafun sau on sabu rabobis on men arimon rabob emon sinmisiririn men.
Osi siyau, “Baibebeotim, Moses iyau, orot iyafan intabin nanatun ambin inarab on tain giya orot on tuan an kena iniawan ato osi fifirig sinbibitu on tuan orot rabobin on nanatun mes.
Ainauan gigiawan engon nimtereban ruam on nin simama. Ainau orot itabin ato nanatun ambin irabob, on mes on an kena on tain giya orot aurin ikirir.
On bobo kaitamom on tain giya orot aurin imatar, a tain giya orot baitonin ba aurin imatar ato on bobo on ainauan gigiawan nimtereban ruam engon auris imatar.
Au kanfoun on jever irabob.
Ainauan gigiawan engon nimtereban ruam on jever kaitamom siawan ato on an rai sabu rabob emon sinmisiririn men on, orot iyafan on arimon on awan bag?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Omi on totor eta woisarar bag! Yabin omi God an dura buk amonai sigagayam on men wosagob o God an faiwar on men wosagob.
Yabin sabu rabob emon sinmisiririn men on, osi arimon safamai nan anea ba sinmatar ato osi arimon men sintabin on.
Sabu rabob emon sinmisir sinyayawas on: ‘Omi on dura bag God an dura buk amonai sigagayam on woiyab, God iyau,
‘Yau on Abraham an God, Isaac an God, a Jacob an God.’ On on sabu yayawasis asi God, men sabu rabobis asi God.”
Sabu kuayo gagamin on dura si’tatam on, an baibebe aurin on siduduran.
Baifafaro Dura Gagamin Bag
Pharisee yangan sitatam Iesu on Sadducee yangan asi dura ibiyafotes on osi awas sifot, ato osi engon siruayo sinat,
ato osi sanasi orot tani Baifafaro an baibebeotin on ifourtobon Iesu ititetemai on nan itrutobonai mes.
On itetemai iyau, “Baibebeotim, baifafaro dura amonai on menan dura on gagamin bag?”
Iesu iyafotai iyau, “Bada am God on nunuam tutufinai, ayubim tutufinai, a am not tutufinai uninuaboai.’
Atonio dura on gagamin bag a ainauin bag baifafaro dura amonai.
Baifafaro dura bairuin gagamin bag on ato nanaba: ‘Turam uninuaboai ato toum ebinuaboim ba.’
Atonio baifafaro dura ruam on ann bokwakwarin bag Moses an baifafaro dura engon a aubairuruotis asi baibebe auris.”
Keriso aurin Sitetem
Pharisee yangan fani siruayo mom, ato Iesu itetemis iyau,
“Keriso aurin on mamaba wononosin i? On an dam warar on iyafan?” Osi siyafotai siyau, “On min David an dam warar emon.”
Iesu itetemis iyau, “Ato aibo mes God an Ayu on David ibonuai ato Bada aurin iyor iyau, ‘Bada’? David iyau,

content.text: ‘God on Yau au Bada aurin iyau: ‘Om nin au asumaiauai emair ato Yau am ragit anboes sinsur om am baibad babanai sinama.’

content: David On aurin iyor iyau, ‘Bada,’ ato mamaba mes Keriso on David an dam warar emon?”
Osi men iyafan tani fofonin arimon Iesu an dura itiyafotai on, on ra nan on siber men iyafan tani gibui dura tani ba Iesu ititetemai men.
